verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões de Moabe, sim, por quatro, não retirarei o castigo; porque queimou os ossos do rei de Edom, até os reduzir a cal.
verses.en_web: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
verses.en_bbe: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Moab, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because he had the bones of the king of Edom burned to dust.

verses.en: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kirioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
verses.pt: Por isso porei fogo a Moabe, e ele consumirá os palácios de Queriote; e Moabe morrerá com grande estrondo, com alarido, e som de trombeta.
verses.en_web: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;
verses.en_bbe: And I will send a fire on Moab, burning up the great houses of Kerioth: and death will come on Moab with noise and outcries and the sound of the horn:

verses.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E exterminarei o juiz do meio dele, e matarei com ele todos os seus príncipes, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And I will have the judge cut off from among them, and all their captains I will put to death with him, says the Lord.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressoes de Judá, sim, por quatro, não retirarei o castigo; porque rejeitaram a lei do Senhor, e não guardaram os seus estatutos, antes se deixaram enganar por suas próprias mentiras, após as quais andaram seus pais.
verses.en_web: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they have rejected Yahweh’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;
verses.en_bbe: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Judah, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they have given up the law of the Lord, and have not kept his rules; and their false ways, in which their fathers went, have made them go out of the right way.

verses.en: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Por isso porei fogo a Judá, e ele consumirá os palácios de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will send a fire on Judah, burning up the great houses of Jerusalem.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por três transgressões de Israel, sim, por quatro, não retirarei o castigo; porque vendem o justo por dinheiro, e o necessitado por um par de sapatos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes;
verses.en_bbe: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Israel, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they have given the upright man for silver, and the poor for the price of two shoes;

verses.en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
verses.pt: Pisam a cabeça dos pobres no pó da terra, pervertem o caminho dos mansos; um homem e seu pai entram à mesma moça, assim profanando o meu santo nome.
verses.en_web: They trample on the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and deny justice to the oppressed; and a man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name;
verses.en_bbe: Crushing the head of the poor, and turning the steps of the gentle out of the way: and a man and his father go in to the same young woman, putting shame on my holy name:

verses.en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
verses.pt: Também se deitam junto a qualquer altar sobre roupas empenhadas, e na casa de seu Deus bebem o vinho dos que têm sido multados.
verses.en_web: and they lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge; and in the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.
verses.en_bbe: By every altar they are stretched on clothing taken from those who are in their debt, drinking in the house of their god the wine of those who have made payment for wrongdoing.

verses.en: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.pt: Contudo eu destruí o amorreu diante deles, a altura do qual era como a dos cedros, e cuja força era como a dos carvalhos; mas destruí o seu fruto por cima, e as suas raízes por baixo.
verses.en_web: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.en_bbe: Though I sent destruction on the Amorite before them, who was tall as the cedar and strong as the oak-tree, cutting off his fruit from on high and his roots from under the earth.

verses.en: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.pt: Outrossim vos fiz subir da terra do Egito, e quarenta anos vos guiei no deserto, para que possuísseis a terra do amorreu.
verses.en_web: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.en_bbe: And I took you up out of the land of Egypt, guiding you for forty years in the waste land, so that you might take for your heritage the land of the Amorite.

verses.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E dentre vossos filhos suscitei profetas, e dentre os vossos mancebos, nazireus. Acaso não é isso assim, filhos de Israel? diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And some of your sons I made prophets, and some of your young men I made separate for myself. Is it not even so, O children of Israel? says the Lord.

verses.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
verses.pt: Mas vós aos nazireus destes vinho a beber, e aos profetas ordenastes, dizendo: Não profetizeis.
verses.en_web: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
verses.en_bbe: But to those who were separate you gave wine for drink; and to the prophets you said, Be prophets no longer.

verses.en: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
verses.pt: Eis que eu vos apertarei no vosso lugar como se aperta um carro cheio de feixes.
verses.en_web: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am crushing you down, as one is crushed under a cart full of grain.

verses.en: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
verses.pt: Assim de nada valerá a fuga ao ágil, nem o forte corroborará a sua força, nem o valente salvará a sua vida.
verses.en_web: Flight will perish from the swift; and the strong won’t strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver himself;
verses.en_bbe: And flight will be impossible for the quick-footed, and the force of the strong will become feeble, and the man of war will not get away safely:

verses.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
verses.pt: E não ficará em pé o que maneja o arco, nem o ligeiro de pés se livrará, nem tampouco se livrara o que vai montado a cavalo;
verses.en_web: neither shall he stand who handles the bow; and he who is swift of foot won’t escape; neither shall he who rides the horse deliver himself;
verses.en_bbe: And the bowman will not keep his place; he who is quick-footed will not get away safely: and the horseman will not keep his life.

verses.en: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: e aquele que é corajoso entre os valentes fugirá nu naquele dia, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: and he who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And he who is without fear among the fighting men will go in flight without his clothing in that day, says the Lord.
